beats.text: Sri Lanka spends 79.9% of its revenue on debt interest. Germany spends 2.5%.
Sri Lanka is the world's highest, spending 32 times what Germany does.
India sits near the top, spending 34% of its revenue on interest.
This counts interest on debt like bonds and loans paid to domestic and foreign residents.
The USA spends 20.3% of its revenue, right next to Mexico at 20%.
Other major economies spend far less: China is at 3.4%, and Russia 2.4%.
At the bottom, Iraq spends just 0.01%, the world's lowest.
How much of your government's budget goes to paying interest?
